pr_title: patch scale subresources inside guaranteedupdate loop
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
Applies patches sent to scale subresources inside the guaranteedupdate loop, to ensure that a patch without a resourceVersion or uid precondition does not receive a 409 conflict error response.

Also adds test coverage for handling of notfound, uid and resourceVersion conflicts when patching scale subresources.

This matches the fix made for custom resource scale subresource handling done in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/80572#issuecomment-517724451

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #89740

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
kube-apiserver: fixes scale subresource patch handling to avoid returning unnecessary 409 Conflict error to clients
```

/sig apps

Alright, in case other reviewers don't see it.  The store.Update func here https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/registry/generic/registry/store.go#L475 is taking a func that works kind of like `retryOnConflict` for the REST API.  If you don't get new input inside of that retry (what this PR does), you will always conflict.  If you do reget it and do not specify a precondition, the code will re-GET, and retry the update

/lgtm

```
I0416 07:11:14.380344       1 store.go:366] GuaranteedUpdate of /registry/controllers/replication-controller-585/rc-test failed because of a conflict, going to retry
I0416 07:11:14.380640       1 httplog.go:90] verb="PATCH" URI="/api/v1/namespaces/replication-controller-585/replicationcontrollers/rc-test/scale" latency=272.933935ms resp=409 UserAgent="e2e.test/v1.19.0 (linux/amd64) kubernetes/046200c -- [sig-apps] ReplicationController should test the lifecycle of a ReplicationController" srcIP="34.70.33.26:51590":
```

@liggitt is the problem that it should retry per the message, but it never does it?

Yes, this is a real bug.

The application of the patch sent to scale subresources should be done inside the guaranteedupdate loop. Reproducer test and fix in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/90342

The same bug existed in statefulsets, deployments, and replicasets

Made a PR to mark this test as flaky in the meanwhile:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/90354
